reading_scope: Source-use assessments inherited from the exact supplied reports. New integration reads and binds those reports; no new literature campaign, participant experiment or specialist review.
independence_rule: Do not combine different cohorts, tasks, carriers or support histories into one end-to-end witness; duplicated roots and consecutive generations do not create independence.

studies.cohort: Published constructed assembly and subsequent construction sequence
studies.task: Construct another assembly able to continue the generating task

studies.observation_history: The reported constructed assembly performs further construction after the original complete assembly is removed.

studies.source_version_and_read_scope: Article and original supplement as assessed in the supplied report.
studies.dependence: Supplement images and movie observations belong to the same experiment; they are not replications.

studies.cohort: 90 groups in the reported randomized membership-change comparison; 11 later reflection groups

studies.source_version_and_read_scope: Study conditions and reported denominators retained at the report reading scope.

No repeated destroy-source migration or complete certification of external state is shown.
studies.source_version_and_read_scope: Report distinguishes architecture, benchmark and later exercise instead of treating them as one run.

Later image improvements and later training implementation do not backdate qualification.
studies.source_version_and_read_scope: June 2005 observed training cutoff, 2007 implementation and later technical tables remain dated.

studies.carrier: Individual human decision makers with a fictitious group protocol

studies.report_locus: Retained information and real group interaction

studies.source_version_and_read_scope: Study denominator and restrictions retained from the report.
